purpose: Find a fully independent NCEI multibeam reference with materially larger exact spatial overlap with PF0501, without reading bathymetric depth or morphology.
selection_pipeline: Query NCEI multibeam footprint polygons intersecting PF0501 footprint.
Compute exact polygon intersection area with PF0501 in EPSG:4326.
Reject zero-area/touch-only intersections and excluded/calibration surveys.
Require acquisition year >= 2006 to preserve a later independent reference role.
Rank remaining surveys by descending exact intersection area; ties by SURVEY_ID lexical order.
For candidates in rank order, inspect public NCEI directory structure only for generated FNV and FBT availability.
Select the first candidate with both public FNV and FBT derivatives; no depth values may be read during selection.
next_if_candidate_found: Freeze exact PF0501 x candidate footprint/FNV overlap before any depth.
